builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Qiyana: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A terrain-dependent combo assassin who resets Q and passive damage by changing enchantments. Brush stealth and river roots can create another attack or spell window. Change enchantments deliberately to refresh passive/Q opportunities. Wall/river/brush access and ultimate terrain contact cannot be assumed on every target. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Qiyana: Change enchantments deliberately to refresh passive/Q opportunities. Wall/river/brush access and ultimate terrain contact cannot be assumed on every target.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.

The route fails Qiyana's stated kit question: Change enchantments deliberately to refresh passive/Q opportunities. Wall/river/brush access and ultimate terrain contact cannot be assumed on every target.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Youmuu, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: While Qiyana's weapon is Enchanted, she gains [(0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35) × 100]% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal an additional [8 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 40 + (0.45) × AP + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage. She also gains [(0.03 / 0.05 / 0.07 / 0.09 / 0.11) × 100]% Move Speed while out of combat near the corresponding terrain type.

Active: Qiyana dashes towards a nearby brush, terrain, or river and Enchants her weapon with that particular terrain type. This refreshes {{Spell_QiyanaQv2_Name}}'s Cooldown.

Qiyana launches a shockwave that Knocks Back enemies and detonates when it hits terrain. The explosion follows the entire edge of the terrain, Stunning for between 0.5 and [1] seconds and dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (1.25) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [0.1] max Health physical damage. Stun duration scales down with distance the shockwave has travelled.

Any river or brush the shockwave passes through also explode after a delay for the same damage and Stun.

If Qiyana does not have an Enchantment, she slashes, dealing [80 / 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies in a small area. If she does, this Ability gains extra range and an additional effect based on the type of Enchantment:Ice Enchantment: Briefly Roots, then Slows by [20]% for [1] second.Rock Enchantment: Deals an additional [(80 / 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.6, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]))] physical damage to units below [50]% Health.Wild Enchantment: Leaves a trail that turns Qiyana Invisible and grants [20]% Move Speed.

Qiyana's Attacks and Abilities deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=15, perLevel=4, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.25) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.3) × AP] bonus physical damage. This effect has a 25 second per-target Cooldown.

Using {{Spell_QiyanaEnchant_Name}} to gain a different weapon Enchantment resets this effect's Cooldown on all targets.
Qiyana dashes through an enemy and deals [50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to them.

builds.name: Enchanted AP attacker
builds.summary: Test enchanted ap attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test enchanted ap attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Terrashape grants 15-35% attack speed and enchanted attacks add 0.45 AP magic damage; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward retaining enchantment for attacks. Royal Privilege also has 0.3 AP but stays physical, so Gunblade retains AD for the physical rest of her kit.
testPlan: Required state: Choose an element, attack, then change element to reset passive.
Compare three enchanted attacks with a normal Q-W-Q trade.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Q consumes the attack enchantment and standard burst is severely reduced.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not make Royal Privilege magic or let lethality improve W's magic packet.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Hextech Gunblade, Terminus, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Bloodmail adds AD from health and Eclipse shields separate hits, trading one-shot speed for more grass/river cycles.
